meta.style: Crystal Clear Swarovski Glass — NOT frosted, NOT milky
meta.color: White-Silver monochrome, form defined ONLY by light interactions

base_header:
Photorealistic 4K product photograph of a single floating crystal glass sculpture against completely transparent background, PNG alpha channel, no ring, no frame, no surface — only the sculpture exists in empty void.

CRITICAL GLASS STYLE: The glass is NOT frosted, NOT milky, NOT opaque. It is CRYSTAL CLEAR like a hand-cut Swarovski Optik chandelier pendant — completely see-through with the sculptural form revealed EXCLUSIVELY through physical light phenomena: razor-sharp specular reflection streaks on polished planar surfaces, thin brilliant Fresnel rim highlights that trace every edge and curve as luminous white contour lines glowing brighter at grazing incidence angles, visible refraction distortion where background elements appear shifted when viewed through the glass thickness, and caustic light concentrations — focused bright spots projected where the glass geometry acts as a converging lens.
base_footer: MATERIAL: Crystal glass IOR 1.52, Abbe 65, zero absorption, colorless. All surfaces mirror-polished. White-silver monochrome only. RENDER: 512spp path-traced, 12 bounces, filmic tone mapping, no artificial bloom.
lighting: Key light 5600K at 2 o'clock (60deg from top, upper-right) at 45-degree elevation. Fill 4200K at 8 o'clock (240deg, lower-left) at 12% intensity.

icons.name: dashboard
icons.prompt: SUBJECT: A dashboard grid of 4 crystal-clear glass tiles in 2x2 matrix floating weightlessly. Each tile 18x18x3.2mm solid optical crystal, polished to perfection. Tiles visible through: (1) brilliant specular reflection streaks on top faces from key light, (2) refraction — void behind appears shifted through glass thickness, (3) Fresnel rim glow — thin bright outlines on all 12 edges per tile glowing at grazing angles, (4) caustic concentrations where light focuses through corners onto adjacent tile faces through the 2.8mm air gaps. Top-left tile slightly thicker profile catching wider specular. Bottom-left has internal horizontal ridge creating refraction split. Assembly tilted 14deg Y, 6deg X showing depth. Tiles appear as shimmering crystal forms defined by light alone.
